title: Canonical Successor Process Decision Rules v1.2 Candidate
purpose: Make the successor process executable by adding routing, completeness criteria, evidence/severity thresholds, conflict handling, authority split, process-change materiality, lineage fallback, rollback timing, backlog behavior, enforcement status, budget routing, outcome-based scoring, protected process control and zero-delta health.

delta_dependencies.reason: v1.2 refines the tracked v1.1 process candidate.

SPH3-INV-002 COHERENT_COMPLETE packet omissions fail packet construction rather than reviewer quality
SPH3-INV-003 blocking/freezing/closure/escalation actions satisfy evidence-by-severity thresholds
SPH3-INV-004 verified E3/E4 conflicts freeze affected scope pending higher-order diagnosis
SPH3-INV-005 protected semantics cannot enter MAJOR_DELEGABLE
SPH3-INV-006 process-change re-review burden is proportional to assessed materiality
SPH3-INV-007 unknown reviewer lineage never creates unearned confirmed independence
SPH3-INV-008 rollback timing begins at promotion and preserves remaining decision time through qualifying attribution delay
SPH3-INV-009 semantic admission stops at capacity while review/candidate preparation continues
SPH3-INV-010 every admitted semantic delta declares enforcement status
SPH3-INV-011 escalation spending cannot bypass the global daily OpenRouter ceiling
SPH3-INV-012 reviewer allocation is dominated by external verified outcomes rather than Challenger taste
SPH3-INV-013 canonical-update process semantics are protected from self-amendment
SPH3-INV-014 prolonged zero-admit periods produce typed health diagnosis rather than being treated as automatically healthy
